title: Tang Ancestral Hall (Ha Tsuen)

buildingCutout.basis: Named Lands Department polygon preserving the extent of the three-hall compound.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Lands Department terrain in the paved forecourt, three metres in front of the surveyed hall.

mapIdentity.provider: Hong Kong Lands Department Building survey

identities.name: Tang Ancestral Hall (Ha Tsuen)
identities.address: Ha Tsuen Shi, Yuen Long, New Territories, Hong Kong

mapIdentity.scope: Official Lands Department building polygon, published HKPD base and roof heights, the original local five-metre DTM, one exact cleared Qualla exterior photograph and AMO hall and restoration records.

note: The three timber-roofed halls stand in axial sequence with open courts between them. The lower columns are stone and the walls gray masonry. The low drum platforms flank the protected central entry, and two side chambers occupy the last courtyard.
